name: spectral-resonance-chladni-closure
title: Combinatorial Euler-Sieve Identities, Hadamard-Poisson Flux Detection, and Conditional Nodal-Wall Identities for Riemann's Xi-Function
summary: Establishes the finite cubic-window Dirichlet identity for zeta(s)*E_X(s), the closed-form Poisson-Hadamard lobe integral -arcsin(d/d_*), Sylvester inertia detection on a pole-free entire two-zero perturbation, and local Cauchy-Riemann nodal-wall relations, while proving explicit obstructions from complex zeros F_2(-1 +- i) = 0, Kronecker small-prime alignment, nodal-curve counterexamples, and the pure-imaginary root Phi(i*eta_0) = 0 at eta_0 = 0.319415... < pi/8.
